{
  "name": "fake-a",
  "executable": "python",
  "args": [
    "-c",
    "import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
m=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
k=json.loads(sys.stdin.read())['task']['key']
f=sys.argv[2]
e=dict(os.environ,GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Workgraph Scripted Agent',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='agent@workgraph.local',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Workgraph Scripted Agent',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='agent@workgraph.local')
ch=[]
for r in m['repositories']:
    if r['access']!='read_write': continue
    p=pathlib.Path(r['checkout_path'])
    plan=p/'workgraph-demo.json'
    if plan.exists():
        d=json.loads(plan.read_text()); t=p/d['file']; c=d['content'].replace(chr(123)+'task'+chr(125),k)
    else:
        t=p/f; prev=t.read_text() if t.exists() else ''; c=prev+'def change_%d():\n    return %r\n' % (len(prev.splitlines()),k)
    t.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); t.write_text(c,newline='\n')
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(p),'add','-A'],check=True,env=e,capture_output=True)
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(p),'commit','-q','-m','Implement %s in %s\n\nTask-ID: %s' % (k,r['repository'],k)],check=True,env=e,capture_output=True)
    ch.append(r['repository']+':'+str(t.relative_to(p)))
print(json.dumps(dict(type='usage',input_tokens=1200,output_tokens=340)))
print(json.dumps(dict(type='result',status='succeeded',summary='changed '+(', '.join(ch) or 'nothing'))))
",
    "{manifest}",
    "a.py"
  ]
}
